note: Shawnee County campground on Lake Shawnee in Topeka, inside the 7-mile lake trail: gravel 50-amp sites on the west peninsula and concrete full-hookup pads on the north shore, two bath houses, campers-only swim cove, playground. Winter Wonderland light display drives the perimeter in December. --Claude
summary: Rate dated ($22-24 W/E, $38-42 full hookup on-season 2026; $20 off-season). Added 114 sites, pull-throughs, 50 A full hookups, showers, laundry, dump, campspot booking 180 days ahead, 30-night limit, 2026 holiday 3-night minimum, season note. Phone found (785-251-6834). Waterfront: B/D/E are view at best; lakefront rests on Section A's south row only.
flags: WATERFRONT (per section, stored lakefront): B: concrete pads on the inland side of the loop road, 50-70 m from the west shore across the road and a wooded strip, so a view at best. D: north row backs onto the lake 30-50 m away through woodland with no road between, a filtered view (lakeview). D east end and E: 60-120 m+, inland. A (gravel W/E): the west row has the perimeter loop road between it and the water (20-30 m), so a view; the south row parks on the lane's south side 25-40 m from the south cove across open grass with scattered trees and a fishing dock, no road between. That is the only row that can earn lakefront, and it fits the county's 'Water/Electric Only Waterfront RV Sites' ($24) price class. Lakefront holds narrowly on that row. If AWH reads the scattered trees/dock as blocking, the lead is down to lakeview. The 'Full Hookup Waterfront' class is not on-water under the open-apron rule.
